true_memory.speaker: RECOVERED MEMORY
true_memory.text: Mira told me to abort. I overrode the lockout because I wanted to finish the scan.

true_memory.speaker: VOICE
true_memory.text: The Core destabilized. The emergency shutdown was interrupted before the Core could be isolated.

true_memory.speaker: ARIN [YOU]
true_memory.text: I got out... but Mira stayed behind. I can't remember what happened to her.

true_memory.speaker: VOICE
true_memory.text: The final recording is in the Core chamber. Recover the full shutdown procedure.

false_memory.speaker: FALSE MEMORY
false_memory.text: The safety lockout failed on its own. Arin had no choice.

false_memory.speaker: VOICE
false_memory.text: That's the false version. The records show that the override was deliberate. Reorder the events.
